title: Precision agricultural robotic sprayer with real-time Tobacco recognition and spraying system based on deep learning
summary: Deep-learning crop recognition drove a real-time variable-rate tobacco sprayer; field experiments evaluated recognition and targeted spraying, demonstrating a specific precision-agriculture result.
ai_technology: Deep-learning tobacco-recognition model for variable-rate spraying
organization: Advanced Robotics and Automation Laboratory; National Centre of Robotics and Automation (NCRA)

evidence.tested: Deep-learning crop recognition drove a real-time variable-rate tobacco sprayer; field experiments evaluated recognition and targeted spraying, demonstrating a specific precision-agriculture result.
evidence.unknown: The reported result is limited to the study data, samples and conditions; broader application was not established.
evidence.ai_role: Detects tobacco plants from field imagery and drives a real-time variable-rate sprayer evaluated in field experiments.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
